newsitem.title: USA: Patterson Dental Q1 July 26 margin rises.
newsitem.headline: Patterson Dental Q1 July 26 margin rises.

text.p: Patterson Dental Co on Thursday said its gross margin rose to 36.5 percent in its fiscal first quarter from 35.2 percent in the same period a year ago.
The improvement in the three months ended July 26 reflected the favorable impact of its Colwell operation, which sells health-care forms and office stationery.

Colwell was acquired in October 1996. Last month, Patterson Dental's direct sales force began selling Colwell products in some cities, and the company said it expected a national rollout to start in the coming months. The products were previously offered through only catalogs and telemarketing.

Separately, Patterson said it had implemented a contingency plan for distributing its products during the United Parcel Service strike. It said it was currently experiencing only minor delays in deliveries.
Earlier Thursday, the company said net income rose to $8.3 million, or $0.38 a share, in the fiscal 1998 first quarter, from $6.2 million, or $0.29 a share, in the year-earlier quarter.
Patterson Dental shares were up 1/4 at 35-3/4 late Thursday afternoon.
